edit.description: runs row from the requirement node

summary: a script verifier names the tool that runs it, and that reference is a graph edge the tool's degree counts
acceptance: a requirement whose script verifier names a { file } tool leaves it with no tool.degree finding; a toolless verifier is still accepted
tests: a script verifier naming a file tool leaves that tool with no degree finding
pins: a script verifier without a tool is still accepted
notes: Class 0104. Follow the tap's shape (A-TAP-REACHES-ITS-TOOL-BY-AN-EDGE): the edge leaves the (requirement, <name>) node via a root runs row.
